description: This file declares the Eos class, which is a task related to WebAudioPlayer in the Rialto server component. It includes class declaration, constructor, destructor, and execute method, along with private members for context and GstWrapper.

classes.name: Eos
classes.description: Represents an End Of Stream (EOS) task for WebAudioPlayer, responsible for handling EOS events within the Rialto server's WebAudio subsystem.

methods.name: Eos
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Eos task with the WebAudioPlayerContext and a shared pointer to IGstWrapper.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the EOS task, likely signaling the end of stream to the WebAudioPlayer.
